6.388 rsAggregateIndicatorFieldOnCalculatedField
Applies to RDL 2011/01
rsAggregateIndicatorFieldOnCalculatedField is a critical error that occurs when both
Field.AggregateIndicatorField and Field.Value are specified on the same Field.
